[element-sec]
=== `<sec>` Section

Headed group of material; the basic structural unit of the body of a standards document.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Recursive Sections

Standards documents are almost invariably divided into sections, each with a title that describes the content of the section, such as “Introduction”, “Scope”, “Normative References”, or “Terms and definitions”. In the NISO STS Tag Sets, sections are recursive, that is, various levels of sections are indicated by containment, not by different names for the subsections. A <<element-sec,`<sec>`>> element may contain lower level sections that are also tagged using the <<element-sec,`<sec>`>> element, not tagged explicitly as <sec2>, <sec3>, or <subsec1>, etc.
##### Section Types

Best Practice is to use the <<attribute-sec-type,`@sec-type`>> attribute to provide semantic classing of many sections. See the <<attribute-sec-type,`@sec-type`>> page for suggested values.
#### Placement of Sections

NISO STS standards documents are written in sections, not only within the narrative <<element-body,`<body>`>> of the standards document, but also: At the end of the front matter (<<element-front,`<front>`>>), following the standard’s metadata, to hold material that is logically part of the front matter, not part of the body of a standards document; and Within the back matter (<<element-back,`<back>`>>) to tag material that has not been explicitly named as one of the other back matter components, that is, it is not named as an annex (<<element-app,`<app>`>>), an acknowledgment (<<element-ack,`<ack>`>>), a bibliography (<<element-ref-list,`<ref-list>`>>), etc.

</sec>

  ...

   <label>6.4.1</label>
   <title>Test Charts for linear symbologies</title>
   <p>A set of bar code test charts is defined, which 
    shall be used for the tests indicated ...</p>
   ...
  </sec>
  <sec id="s6.4.2">
   <label>6.4.2</label>
   <title>Test charts for multi-row and composite symbols</title>
   <sec id="s6.4.2.1">
    <label>6.4.2.1</label>
    <title>PDF417</title>
    <p>A set of PDF417 test charts defined in 
     <xref ref-type="table" rid="t4">Table 4</xref> 
     shall be used.</p>
    ...

   ...
  </sec>
  ...
 </sec>

</sec>
